highlights: Consolidated EBITDA stood at INR 1,191 crore, registering a growth of 29% year-on-year, with margins improving to 15.6% from 14.9% in quarter two last year.

highlights: Consolidated EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR 1,092 crore, registering a growth of 28%, with EBITDA margin improving from 15.5% to 14.6% for the Q1 last year.
